# Checklist

- [ ] One coherent roadmap item; no unrelated changes
- [ ] Tests added or updated for changed behavior

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## Unreleased` for user-visible changes

- [ ] Nearest folder-local `AGENTS.md` updated if the folder's map or rules changed
- [ ] Keyboard, screen reader, reduced motion, and contrast considered for UI changes
- [ ] No new dependency — or the justification is written below
- [ ] No new third-party origin, script, cookie, or network call — or the threat model is updated
- [ ] Imported content has documented provenance and licence in `docs/content/sources.md` and `NOTICE`
